intro: Level 2 Sound Healing Course in Bali Indonesia – Ancient wisdom meets modern science. Master beyond basic sound healing techniques.

Allow the crystalline vibrations to guide you as you dive into the magical realm of Tibetan singing bowls. Explore techniques that employ the power of these extraordinary instruments, connecting you with a harmony that transcends the boundaries of time and space.

Feel the rhythmic pulses of the gong resonate through your being as you immerse yourself in the art of gong techniques. Our workshop reveals the secrets of mastering this ancient instrument, allowing you to create waves of balance and harmony.
Dive into the fascinating world where tradition and science harmonise. Explore modern scientific research, and uncover the secrets of sound and vibration through the lens of numbers and hertz.

curriculum.title: What You Will Learn
items: The transformative power of Tibetan singing bowls to aid both yourself and others.
Uncover techniques to release negative emotions—fear, anxiety, anger, irritation—and achieve harmony in your psycho-emotional well-being.
Navigate the art of selecting the right bowl and set tailored to your individual practice, whether for meditation or massage.
Explore the intricacies of vibro-acoustic massage using Tibetan singing bowls.
Become adept in the “Massage with Tibetan Singing Bowls” technique through hands-on contact.
Master the “Sound Bath” technique, a non-contact method for immersive sonic experiences.
Acquire the knowledge and skills to lead group meditations with the resonant energy of Tibetan singing bowls.
Delve into the techniques of working with the subtle structures of individuals.
Learn to conduct specialised sessions for pairs, pregnant women, water sessions, and more.
Gain insights into the therapeutic applications of Tibetan singing bowls for various diseases.
Discover the art of cleansing and harmonising spaces using the resonance of these enchanting bowls.
Explore the relationship between the sound of the bowls and the energy centres of human chakras.
Learn to purify crystals and structure water with the transformative vibrations of Tibetan singing bowls.
Explore concepts like the Schumann resonance frequency and Prayer Vigilance.
Develop the skill to create your own binaural beats.
Learn to identify the note a bowl produces and understand the corresponding frequencies in hertz.
Gain insights into the planetary system and how it connects with the bowls and our solar system.
Delve into the technology of a sound bath with the mystical resonance of the gong.
Acquire the expertise to lead both private and group sessions with the Gong, creating transformative sonic experiences.

issues: 'What You Will Learn' list (gong sessions, sound bath, binaural beats, Schumann resonance, planetary system, sessions for pregnant women, therapeutic applications 'for various diseases') goes far beyond the 7-item Level 2 syllabus; sound bath appears in the Level 3 syllabus on other pages and gong is not in any Ubud syllabus. Likely copied from a different (longer) course — confirm before publishing.
'Learning Outcomes' list is identical to the Level 1 page's outcomes (not Level-2-specific).
Booking text is self-contradictory: 'deposit the Complete course fees of 100 USD' and refers to 'yoga retreat fees'.
Inclusions list 'Private accommodation with 24h hot water availability' for all options, including Twin Shared and Only Course.
No prerequisite stated (e.g. completion of Level 1) even though this is Level 2; audience list says 'meditation enthusiasts, whether experienced or newbies'.
Course hours are not stated (hours = null).

Page contains a 'Positive Effects of Meditation/Massage with Tibetan Singing Bowls and Gong' list with unverified health claims (e.g. removes stress and depressive conditions, synchronises the cerebral hemispheres, 'Fears, worries, and resentments disappear') — not extracted.
Intro mentions 'Discover the synchronisation between the vibrations of our brains and the planet' — pseudo-scientific claim, omitted from intro.
Duplicate URL /courses/level-2-sound-healing-course-in-bali-indonesia-2/ exists with different content (it is actually a Level 1&2 page with different prices) — see duplicates report.
